name: smartroute
description: SmartRoute bus booking + live tracking. The app itself is pure C17 + C++17 (hand-written data structures) with one embedded HTML page and NO npm dependencies - this file only exists so 'npm install' then 'npm run dev' works as a launcher, forwarding to run-web.cmd / the Makefile.

scripts.install: node -e "console.log('SmartRoute needs no packages. Next: npm run dev  (builds with make if needed and opens http://localhost:8080)')"
